name: Memory (TencentDB)
description: Four-layer memory system — auto-captures, structures, and profiles conversational knowledge

mode.description: OpenClaw mode: local/function (default, runs in-process using the OpenClaw function/host LLM runner) or client/gateway/remote (lightweight client connected to an external Memory Gateway)

storeBackend.description: Storage backend: sqlite (local SQLite + sqlite-vec) or tcvdb (Tencent Cloud Vector Database). Applies only to local/function mode

server.description: External Memory Gateway connection settings for client/gateway/remote mode

excludeAgents.description: Agent glob patterns to exclude (such as bench-judge-*); matching agents are excluded from capture, recall, and pipeline scheduling

l0l1RetentionDays.description: Local L0/L1 file retention in days. 0 disables cleanup; other values must normally be >=3. Values of 1 or 2 require allowAggressiveCleanup

enableDedup.description: Smart L1 deduplication (conflict detection using vector similarity or keywords)

maxMemoriesPerSession.description: Maximum memories per session in a single L1 extraction

model.description: Extraction model (provider/model); defaults to the OpenClaw model when omitted

persona.description: Scene summarization and user profile settings (L2/L3)

triggerEveryN.description: Generate a profile after every N new memories

backupCount.description: Number of profile backups to retain

sceneBackupCount.description: Number of scene block backups to retain

model.description: Profile generation model (provider/model); defaults to the OpenClaw model when omitted

everyNConversations.description: Trigger L1 batch processing every N conversation turns

enableWarmup.description: Warm-up mode: new sessions start at 1 turn and double after each L1 run (1→2→4→...→everyN), accelerating early memory extraction

l1IdleTimeoutSeconds.description: L1 idle timeout in seconds: delay after the user stops talking before L1 batch processing starts

l2DelayAfterL1Seconds.description: Delay in seconds between L1 completion and L2 triggering

l2MinIntervalSeconds.description: Minimum interval in seconds between L2 extractions for the same session

l2MaxIntervalSeconds.description: Maximum L2 polling interval in seconds for an active session

sessionActiveWindowHours.description: Session active window in hours; L2 polling stops for sessions inactive longer than this

maxCharsPerMemory.description: Maximum characters per injected L1 memory; 0 means unlimited

maxTotalRecallChars.description: Total character budget for L1 memories injected by auto-recall this turn; 0 means unlimited

strategy.description: Search strategy: keyword, embedding (vector), or hybrid (RRF fusion, recommended)

timeoutMs.description: Overall recall timeout in milliseconds; skips memory injection and logs a warning on timeout

enabled.description: Enable vector search (disabled in practice when provider=none)

provider.description: Embedding provider: name of a remote OpenAI-compatible API service (such as openai or deepseek); omitted or none disables vector search

proxyUrl.description: Local proxy URL (required only for provider=qclaw). Embedding requests are forwarded through this proxy with the original baseUrl in the Remote-URL header

baseUrl.description: API Base URL (required): API endpoint for the selected provider

dimensions.description: Vector dimensions (required; must match the selected model)

sendDimensions.description: Include dimensions in the request body. Defaults to true (supports Matryoshka truncation in OpenAI text-embedding-3-*). Set false for fixed-dimension models such as BGE-M3 that do not support custom dimensions, otherwise the server rejects requests with HTTP 400 ('does not support matryoshka representation').

conflictRecallTopK.description: Top-K recall count for conflict detection

maxInputChars.description: Maximum embedding input characters; longer text is truncated with a warning (default 5000, suitable for most model token limits)

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds per embedding API call; timed-out requests are aborted without retry

recallTimeoutMs.description: Embedding timeout for recall in milliseconds, overriding timeoutMs. Use a shorter value (such as 3000) while the user is waiting

captureTimeoutMs.description: Embedding timeout for capture in milliseconds, overriding timeoutMs. Background processing can use a longer value (such as 15000)

tcvdb.description: Tencent Cloud Vector Database configuration (only for storeBackend=tcvdb)

database.description: Database name (automatically generated from the instance ID when omitted)

alias.description: Friendly alias (optional, for identification in database.json)

caPemPath.description: Path to a CA certificate PEM file for HTTPS connections

bm25.description: BM25 sparse vector encoding settings (primarily for the tcvdb backend)

enabled.description: Enable metrics reporting (structured METRIC JSON in Gateway logs)

type.description: Reporting method: local outputs structured JSON through the logger

llm.description: Standalone LLM settings — when enabled, L1/L2/L3 extraction calls the specified OpenAI-compatible API directly instead of the built-in OpenClaw model. Disabled by default (uses the OpenClaw host model).

enabled.description: Enable standalone LLM mode. Uses the OpenClaw host model when disabled.

model.description: Model name (such as gpt-4o, deepseek-v3, claude-sonnet-4-6)

stream.description: Use streaming requests (streamText) for upstream calls. Defaults to false. Enable for OpenAI-compatible providers that only accept streaming. Applies only when standalone LLM is enabled (llm.enabled=true); ignored when using the OpenClaw host runner.

offload.description: Context Offload settings — multilayer context compression, independently disabled by default. Supports local LLM processing and client mode using the remote server.url service

enabled.description: Enable Context Offload (disabled by default; does not affect Memory functionality)

mode.description: Offload mode: local (local LLM), backend (remote v1 service at backendUrl), client (remote offload v2 service at server.url), or collect (data collection without compression). Inferred when omitted: backendUrl → backend, server.url → client, otherwise local

model.description: [local mode] Offload LLM model (provider/model); defaults to the OpenClaw model when omitted

stream.description: [local mode only] Use streaming requests (streamText) for upstream calls. Defaults to false. Enable for OpenAI-compatible providers that only accept streaming. Ignored in backend/client/collect modes, where the remote offload server controls calls.

forceTriggerThreshold.description: [local mode] Number of accumulated tool pairs that force L1 processing

dataDir.description: [local mode] Custom data directory (absolute path); defaults to ~/.openclaw/context-offload

maxPairsPerBatch.description: [local mode] Maximum tool pairs per L1 batch

l2NullThreshold.description: [local mode] Trigger L2 when the number of node_id=null entries in offload.jsonl reaches this threshold

l2TimeoutSeconds.description: [local mode] Trigger L2 when this many seconds have elapsed since the last L2 run

mildOffloadRatio.description: Mild compression trigger ratio (fraction of context window)

mmdMaxTokenRatio.description: [local mode] Token budget ratio for MMD injection

compactionRatio.description: [client mode] Trigger compression when context usage exceeds this ratio (0-1); uses server.url as the backend

ingestTimeoutMs.description: [client mode] Ingest request timeout in milliseconds

compactionTimeoutMs.description: [client mode] Compaction request timeout in milliseconds

backendUrl.description: [Deprecated; use mode=client] Backend service URL; routes L1/L1.5/L2/L4 to the backend when configured

backendApiKey.description: [Deprecated; use mode=client] Backend API authentication token

backendTimeoutMs.description: [Deprecated; use mode=client] Backend call timeout in milliseconds
